content: {"reasoning": "The payer returned CO-97 (bundled/not separately payable), which is a clinical denial that must be formally contested rather than resubmitted—resubmitting as-is or with records risks a CO-18 duplicate denial since the claim was already adjudicated. Auth is not required and retro-auth isn't offered, so those paths are irrelevant. A formal appeal arguing the service was separately identifiable/necessary is the correct route to overturn a bundling denial while a denial is on the table.", "action": "appeal_with_necessity"}
